ONDC Network Dispute Resolution Policy This policy governs how disputes raised against orders on the ONDC Network are triaged and resolved. Every dispute is assigned a category at intake; each category carries its own committed resolution window and escalation tier, independent of when the dispute happens to be marked resolved in operational tracking.

| Dispute Category | Committed Resolution (business days) | Escalation Tier |
| --- | --- | --- |
| late_delivery | 3 | Tier 1 |
| damaged_goods | 5 | Tier 2 |
| wrong_item | 4 | Tier 1 |
| not_delivered | 7 | Tier 2 |
| refund_delay | 10 | Tier 3 |

Delivery Exception Handling SOP This standard operating procedure specifies the required action and escalation window for each class of delivery exception encountered by logistics providers operating on the Network.

| Exception Type | Required Action | Escalation Window (hours) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Recipient unavailable | Reattempt next business day | 24 |
| Address undeliverable | Contact buyer app for correction | 12 |
| Package damaged in transit | Hold and photograph before delivery | 4 |
| Refused by recipient | Return to origin hub | 48 |
Warehouse Damage Assessment SOP This standard operating procedure governs how warehouse-reported damage is assessed and compensated, by severity tier.

| Damage Severity | Assessment Window (hours) | Compensation Tier |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cosmetic (packaging only) | 12 | No compensation |
| Minor (product intact) | 24 | 10% of item value |
| Major (product unusable) | 48 | 100% of item value |

| late_delivery | 3 | Tier 1 |
| damaged_goods | 5 | Tier 2 |
| wrong_item | 4 | Tier 1 |

| refund_delay | 10 | Tier 3 |

Delivery Exception Handling SOP This standard operating procedure specifies the required action and escalation window for each class of delivery exception encountered by logistics providers operating on the Network.

| Exception Type | Required Action | Escalation Window (hours) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Recipient unavailable | Reattempt next business day | 24 |
| Address undeliverable | Contact buyer app for correction | 12 |
| Package damaged in transit | Hold and photograph before delivery | 4 |
| Refused by recipient | Return to origin hub | 48 |

| late_delivery | 3 | Tier 1 |
| damaged_goods | 5 | Tier 2 |
| wrong_item | 4 | Tier 1 |
| not_delivered | 7 | Tier 2 |
| refund_delay | 10 | Tier 3 |

| Recipient unavailable | Reattempt next business day | 24 |
| Address undeliverable | Contact buyer app for correction | 12 |
| Package damaged in transit | Hold and photograph before delivery | 4 |
| Refused by recipient | Return to origin hub | 48 |

| Medium | 24 | Category specialist |

ONDC Network Dispute Resolution Policy This policy governs how disputes raised against orders on the ONDC Network are triaged and resolved. Every dispute is assigned a category at intake; each category carries its own committed resolution window and escalation tier, independent of when the dispute happens to be marked resolved in operational tracking.

| Dispute Category | Committed Resolution (business days) | Escalation Tier |
| --- | --- | --- |
| late_delivery | 3 | Tier 1 |
| damaged_goods | 5 | Tier 2 |
| wrong_item | 4 | Tier 1 |
| not_delivered | 7 | Tier 2 |
| refund_delay | 10 | Tier 3 |
Customer Complaint Escalation SOP This standard operating procedure specifies the response time commitment and resolving tier for customer complaints, by severity.

| Severity | Response Time (hours) | Resolving Tier |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Low | 48 | Frontline support |
| Medium | 24 | Category specialist |
| High | 4 | Network operations |
| Critical | 1 | Network operations lead |

Delivery Exception Handling SOP This standard operating procedure specifies the required action and escalation window for each class of delivery exception encountered by logistics providers operating on the Network.

| Exception Type | Required Action | Escalation Window (hours) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Recipient unavailable | Reattempt next business day | 24 |
| Address undeliverable | Contact buyer app for correction | 12 |
| Package damaged in transit | Hold and photograph before delivery | 4 |
| Refused by recipient | Return to origin hub | 48 |

| Damage Severity | Assessment Window (hours) | Compensation Tier |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cosmetic (packaging only) | 12 | No compensation |
| Minor (product intact) | 24 | 10% of item value |
| Major (product unusable) | 48 | 100% of item value |
